duration_seconds.description: Requested lifetime in seconds; quote the exact creation duration. Legacy 0 means unlimited.

legacy_node_id.description: Include only when selecting a node that supports legacy GPU allocation. Current DRA-managed nodes require gpu_mode=dra and gpu_selection instead.

gpu_selection.description: DRA selection; required when using DRA. Match count to num_gpu/gpu_count.

count.description: GPU count; must match the workload GPU count.

allocation.description: builtin_whole for whole GPUs, or config for configured allocation.
